methodology.execution_base_fee_burn_eth: baseFeePerGas (wei) * gasUsed / 1e18; excludes blob gas burn, tips, MEV
methodology.anomaly: gas-utilization > rolling prior 12 blocks median + 3 * max(1.4826*MAD, 0.05)
methodology.scope: block-header observations only; does not measure token transfers, DeFi protocol flow, users or PnL
